lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet already exposed card analysis, market prices, releases, promotions/events, purchase sources, learning and tablet management, while V400 scored only five surfaces and the browser kept a fixed category order regardless of verified operational deficits or current non-directional activity signals.
lessons.prevention_rule: Extend the evidence portfolio with purchase-availability and tablet-operations surfaces, derive UI category priority only from verified surface urgency/confidence plus non-directional release/event/market activity, reorder only the existing allowlisted categories, require a local user override with exact original-order restore, and keep all fact generation, source rewrite, arbitrary command, Git/main write and market-direction inference forbidden.
validation_required: watched runtime paths are exactly tablet_autonomous_evolution_v400.py, tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.css and tablet_autonomy_dashboard_v400.js
surface portfolio includes ui, card_measurement, card_market, card_release, collab_event, purchase_availability and tablet_ops
purchase evidence uses freshness, link health, region/game/source coverage and requires final stock confirmation
tablet operations evidence distinguishes static runtime presence from physical-device verification
adaptive UI order contains only grade, market, box, news, purchase, learning, tablet and code
AI layout can be disabled by the user and restores the original category order
market activity is an attention signal only and never infers market direction
source code auto-generation/rewrite, arbitrary command execution, Git/main runtime writes, price/grade/stock/release/event invention remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V396 expands verified diagnosis and reversible presentation ordering only. It does not let the model author or execute new source code at runtime, invent market or card facts, bypass V399/V398 or earlier hard gates, change service-worker cache ABI, or claim Lenovo/Drive success without device evidence.
